value.title: Public Decision Packet projection
value.question: How should a public Decision Packet be shown without creating a second UI implementation?
value.recommendation: Project the Packet into semantic-map and render it through the approved semantic-map capability. tampered
value.rationale: The Packet remains the shared human and agent meaning. The adapter owns only validation and projection, while the existing semantic-map package owns visual and interaction behavior.
value.next_action: Run exact-head package, capability, reproducibility and Chromium proofs before opening a merge candidate.

changed_since_previous.label: Latest UI base
changed_since_previous.summary: The candidate uses the exact tree of ui proposals at 2e644226.

changed_since_previous.label: Approved UI oracle
changed_since_previous.summary: The semantic-map package replaces the rejected one-off Decision Room mock.

alternatives.label: Create another Decision Room renderer
alternatives.summary: Rejected because it duplicates visual meaning and ignores the approved UI.

alternatives.label: Generate only static prose HTML
alternatives.summary: Deferred to web-publication because route and discovery-ready document ownership is outside ui.

evidence_for.label: Semantic-map capability
evidence_for.summary: Graph, Map, Seq and Chart fixtures execute through one reusable package.

evidence_for.label: Capability registry boundary
evidence_for.summary: The shell selects a thin adapter and verifies the exact package runtime closure.

evidence_against.label: Client-rendered surface
evidence_against.summary: The interactive map does not by itself close semantic initial HTML for search and LLM discovery.

conditions.label: Public only
conditions.summary: privacy_class must be public and the packet must contain no HTML, secret-like value or email-like value.

conditions.label: Non-authority
conditions.summary: The Packet, map, HTML, receipts and examples remain disposable projections.

gaps.label: Discovery-ready document
gaps.summary: A separate web-publication projection is still required for semantic initial HTML and public routes.

success_conditions.label: Deterministic
success_conditions.summary: Two builds from the same Packet produce byte-identical output.

success_conditions.label: No redesign
success_conditions.summary: The adapter adds no page-specific CSS, component tree or alternate renderer.

success_conditions.label: Fail closed
success_conditions.summary: Private, malformed, tampered and authority-confusing packets are rejected.
